description: Use when an agent needs a yes or no on an action before it acts, without waiting for a person. Approves or denies instantly against a human-set policy: a trust check on the counterparty plus an amount limit. Returns approved/denied/review_required with reasons and a signed receipt; anything over the policy line or with a caution counterparty escalates to /review. Input: ?action=&counterparty=&amount= (counterparty required) Price: $0.02 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402.

action.description: What the agent wants to do (e.g. pay invoice)

counterparty.description: Domain or wallet on the other side (required) (e.g. stripe.com)
